# dugout

> Shared awareness for a team's coding agents: see what other agents have in flight and resolve merge conflicts before they happen.

## Core Resources

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/joacofg/dugout): Source code, documentation, and issue tracker.

## AI Agent & LLM Indexing

- Structured following the standard /llms.txt specification for AI search engines and coding assistants.
- Validated via [AccessGuard AI-Readiness Suite](https://ronanchnlps-bit.github.io/).
